_comment: Optional hardening, committed so it travels with the repo.
sandbox.network.strictAllowlist is deliberately ignored when it comes from
repo you cloned could silently redefine your egress policy. It IS honored from
user settings, managed/policy settings, or the --settings flag, so this file is
the portable way to opt in:
WITHOUT this flag file, allowedDomains in .claude/settings.json enforces
NOTHING — it is inert unless strictAllowlist comes from an honored source.
Verified: with the committed project config alone, example.com and pypi.org
are both reachable from a sandboxed command. Filesystem confinement and the
credential denials in settings.json do apply; egress confinement does not.
With this file, hosts outside allowedDomains are refused.
